Plot prototype EEMs of a self-organising map

Source: R/plot_functions.R
ggeem.eemsom.Rd

The prototype EEMs (codebook vectors) of all units or selected units are plotted. If all units are plotted, the facets are arranged like the units on the map (top row of the map first).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'eemsom'
ggeem(data, fill_max = FALSE, units = NULL, denormalise = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

data

object of class eemsom, see eemsom

fill_max

sets the maximum fluorescence value for the colour scale, see ggeem

units

optional numeric vector of units to be plotted

denormalise

logical, see eemsom_codes

...

parameters passed on to ggeem, e.g. colpal or contour

Value

a ggplot object

Details

The facet titles show the unit and the number of samples mapped to this unit. On a hexagonal map, every second row is shifted by half a unit, which cannot be shown by the facets.

Ejarque-Gonzalez and Butturini (2014) used the prototype EEMs to describe the characteristic fluorescence of the regions of the map.

References

Ejarque-Gonzalez, E., Butturini, A. (2014). Self-Organising Maps and Correlation Analysis as a Tool to Explore Patterns in Excitation-Emission Matrix Data Sets and to Discriminate Dissolved Organic Matter Fluorescence Components. PLoS ONE 9(6), e99618. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0099618

See also

ggeem, eemsom_codes

Other plots: eemsom_plot_cplane(), eemsom_plot_map(), eemsom_plot_silhouette(), eemsom_plot_stability(), eemsom_plot_training(), ggeem.eemsom_regions()

Examples

data(eem_list)

som <- eemsom(eem_list, rlen = 100, seed = 42)
ggeem(som)

ggeem(som, units = c(1, 2), contour = TRUE)
